item.description: - Press the mouse wheel and move up to open Overview, or down to show the desktop. - Moving all windows of a workspace in Overview now takes you to that workspace. - Flapping icons in Overview and on the desktop no longer show a frame. - Butterfly now comes as a disk image: open it and drag Butterfly to Applications.

- Apps with a minimum width, like Music and TV, no longer slide over their neighbors on smaller screens. - The tour now teaches Overview and showing the desktop, and only takes your gestures while its window is in front. - When macOS uses the same trackpad gestures, Butterfly tells you exactly which switches to turn off. - License checks recover as soon as your Mac is back online, with clearer messages about moving a license to another Mac. - Updating from the old Chain app no longer asks for an administrator password.

- Going full screen, for example with a video, no longer moves your windows on the strip or makes them slide back when you return. - Apps that show a small loading window at launch, like Slack, now take their normal place on the strip.
